prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE 1:1 square transparent mineral-overlay master authored on a LOGICAL 16x16 Minecraft pixel grid for exact center-point sampling.
Primary request: Coal Measures QUIET, focused second-pass revision. A short low-angle carbonaceous bench tip, slightly stepped and gently pinched, 2 logical cells thick and only 3 or 4 cells long. A muted gray interior parting interrupts one corner. It is an incomplete deposited layer window, not a dark bar or isolated nugget. This is one incidental physical glimpse of a larger ore deposit; tiled rock carries the overall geological identity.
Scene/backdrop: true RGBA alpha-zero transparency everywhere outside the mineral. No rendered stone, deepslate, matte, checkerboard, scene, or shadow.
Style/medium: crisp Minecraft Java 16x16 pixel art made from large hard-edged square logical cells about one-sixteenth of canvas width. All significant physical detail must survive exact 16x16 center sampling. Mostly opaque flat-color pixels, no tiny painted scratches or anti-aliased fringe.
Composition/framing: A quiet connected cluster approximately 6–10 visible logical pixels, around 2 cells thick and 3–4 cells long, off-center. Keep at least 4 sampled pixels in one 8-neighbor connected formation; no edge contact requirement. Almost all canvas is fully transparent. Readability comes from chunky logical grouping and local shape, not from darker pigment, highlights or larger spread. Never complete a whole ore seam/network on one block.
Materials/textures: soft medium gray-charcoal around #606466 and warm gray #747570, grouped as two close values INSIDE the patch; restrained against mid-gray stone, no jet-black core or pale edge. Use two close physical values grouped INSIDE the formation, with gentle visible variation against mid-gray host. No pale border, dark outline, bright sparkles, rails, raised/carved effect, or blanket opacity fade.
Constraints: exactly one square PNG at least 1024x1024, untouched mineral-only overlay with genuine transparent alpha and physical hard-edged clusters; no host pixels, text, watermark, panel, label.
Avoid: black horizontal bar, full-width bed, pale parting outline, Black Shale's oblique cleavage; centered emblem, disconnected confetti, smooth painting, photorealism, haze, vignette, glow, gradient, checkerboard backdrop.
disposition: Retained unchanged as first pattern within category; active human review
